capabilities: download GATE vault releases from GitHub
install and update repository files in the vault
preview installation actions before applying them
preserve user-owned files according to repository rules
disambiguation: Not a general vault sync or backup tool; it only installs and updates files from one specific community GATE repository.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Community support is via a Telegram channel, with an optional donation link. Network requests go only to api.github.com and github.com after explicit user action; no analytics or account required.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull files from a shared repository and update them without overwriting personal notes.

relations.evidence: These folders are must to download for working of GATE Simulator Plugin

summary: Installs and updates a community-maintained GATE exam study vault from GitHub releases while preserving the user's own notes.
